signup.termsBody:
Mark Date helps people meet in person by dropping short-lived marks on the map.

You must be over 18. Fake accounts, harassment, hate speech, and illegal content are not allowed.

Marks are deleted after about 2 hours. Chat opens only if both people accept. An anonymous mark does not show the other person’s profile.

If you abuse the app, your account can be suspended or deleted.
signup.privacyBody:
Your location is processed to show nearby Marks; you are not tracked continuously.

Google sign-in may collect your name, email, and profile photo. Messages and photos are stored in match chats.

You can block and report people. You can delete your account in settings; your Marks and chats are removed.

Data is kept on the server. It is not sold to third parties unless the law requires it.
